responsibility: This file implements the RTL caller-save optimization that preserves call-clobbered hard registers when their values remain live across calls. It initializes per-target save/restore feasibility tables, discovers stack save slots and legal save/restore insn patterns via recog and target hooks, tracks referenced and currently saved hard registers while scanning reload’s insn chains, and inserts explicit save and restore instructions around calls. Its central responsibility is late backend management of hard-register liveness across calls using target-specific spill code, distinct from generic reload or IRA allocation policy.
